tasks.title: Design and Implement UEP (Universal Execution Protocol)
tasks.description: Create the core communication layer that enables agent-to-agent interaction, task routing, and context sharing across all agents.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for each UEP component (message passing, context sharing, etc.)
2. Integration tests with mock agents to verify communication flow
3. Performance tests to ensure <1s latency requirement is met
4. Resilience tests with simulated failures to verify retry logic
5. Load tests to ensure scalability with dozens of agents
6. Security tests to verify message integrity and access controls

subtasks.title: Design Message Passing System with Standardized JSON Schema
subtasks.description: Define and implement the message passing subsystem that enables agent-to-agent communication using a standardized JSON schema for all messages.
subtasks.details: Specify the JSON schema for messages, implement message serialization/deserialization, and integrate with a message queue for asynchronous delivery. Ensure compatibility with WebSocket or similar protocols for real-time updates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for schema validation and serialization; integration tests with mock agents to verify message delivery and real-time updates.

subtasks.title: Implement Task State Management Module
subtasks.description: Develop the subsystem responsible for tracking and updating the state of tasks (pending, in-progress, completed, failed) throughout their lifecycle.
subtasks.details: Create data structures and APIs for task state transitions, ensure atomic updates, and provide interfaces for agents to query and update task status.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for state transitions; integration tests to verify correct state propagation in multi-agent scenarios.

subtasks.title: Develop Context Sharing Mechanism
subtasks.description: Build the mechanism for securely sharing and retrieving context data between agents, including access control and efficient serialization.
subtasks.details: Implement a shared context store, define access control policies, and ensure efficient serialization/deserialization of context objects for low-latency access.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for context storage and retrieval; security tests for access control enforcement; performance tests for serialization/deserialization.

subtasks.title: Integrate Event Logging and Tracing for Observability
subtasks.description: Establish comprehensive event logging and tracing across all UEP components to enable monitoring, debugging, and performance analysis.
subtasks.details: Design a structured event log format, implement tracing hooks in all major subsystems, and provide interfaces for querying and exporting logs.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for log generation; integration tests to verify trace completeness; observability tests under simulated load.

subtasks.title: Implement Retry, Fallback, and Timeout Logic for Resilience
subtasks.description: Add robust retry, fallback, and timeout mechanisms to ensure reliable message delivery and task execution under failure conditions, meeting the <1s latency requirement.
subtasks.details: Define retry and fallback policies, implement timeout handling for all asynchronous operations, and ensure system resilience through automated recovery strategies.
subtasks.testStrategy: Resilience tests with simulated failures; latency tests to verify <1s response time; integration tests for end-to-end reliability.
